# Jivamukti Yoga Tribe Gathering 2027

> Jivamukti Yoga Tribe Gathering 2027, Luxembourg Lotus edition: 2–5 September 2027 (Thursday to Sunday) in Luxembourg. Organised by Jivamukti Yoga.

## Key facts

- Dates: 2027-09-02 to 2027-09-05 (2–5 September 2027, Thursday to Sunday)
- Venue: Coque Luxembourg, 2 rue Léon Hengen, L-1745 Luxembourg
- Organiser: Jivamukti Yoga (https://jivamuktiyoga.com)
- Registration: open now at https://openclient.app/studio/28437 (the OPEN app)
- Contact: events@jivamuktiyoga.com
- Schedule: Schedule available soon. No session times have been published.
- City tips: City tips available soon.

## Passes and prices (EUR)

- Full 4 day pass: €450 early bird, €500 regular. 2–5 September 2027. Every Tribe class from Thursday to Sunday.
- 75HR graduates: €400 early bird, €450 regular. Full 4 day pass for teachers certified in the Jivamukti 75-hour foundational teacher training.
- 300HR graduates: €350 early bird, €400 regular. Full 4 day pass for teachers certified in the Jivamukti 300-hour teacher training.

Early bird: The discounted early bird price is only offered to a limited number of people, on a first-come, first-served basis. Graduate prices apply automatically in the OPEN app when you register with the email address you used for your teacher training. Only these passes are on sale: there are no day passes or single-class tickets.

## Teachers

Sharon Gannon, Yogeswari, Camilla Veen, Petros Haffenrichter, Emma Henry, Moritz Ulrich, Martyna Febre, HaChi Yu, Anna Lunegova, Magali Lehners, Alexandra Colombo.
